new_parts.name: rod-A
new_parts.catalog_name: Technic Pin Long with Stop Bush
new_parts.position: first part; long pin lying left to right, ring (stop bush) end on the right

new_parts.name: axle-A
new_parts.position: pushed into the axle hole in rod-A's ring end

what_each_new_part_touches: axle-A goes into the axle hole in rod-A's ring end
where_everything_is_after: axle-A: sticking out of rod-A's ring end

why.problem_solved: Starts a straight cross shaft for the middle of the undercarriage.
why.why_these_parts: A long pin with a stop ring has a pin on one end (to hang beams on) and an axle hole on the other (to join an axle).
why.sets_up_for_later: rod-A's pin end will hold a bent beam (step 5) and a side rail (step 12).
